src:
MOV     AL, 5Ah          ; 0101 1010
CALL    SHOWBIN
XOR     AL, 0Fh          ; flip the low nibble
CALL    SHOWBIN          ; 0101 0101
XOR     AL, 0Fh          ; again: back to 5Ah
CALL    SHOWBIN
XOR     AL, AL           ; zero, ZF = 1
CALL    SHOWBIN

SHOWBIN PROC    NEAR             ; print AL as 8 binary digits and a space
PUSHF                            ; keep the caller's flags
PUSH    AX
PUSH    BX
PUSH    CX
PUSH    DX
MOV     BL, AL
MOV     CX, 8
NEXTBIT:
SHL     BL, 1            ; the top bit falls into CF
MOV     DL, "0"
ADC     DL, 0            ; "0" + CF = "0" or "1"
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    NEXTBIT
MOV     DL, " "
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
POP     DX
POP     CX
POP     BX
POP     AX
POPF
RET
SHOWBIN ENDP
